manifest.motivation: Version 3 repeats the unchanged constrained-output comparison with the hosted OpenAI Responses API to determine whether the prompt treatment effect persists under a different model and provider.
manifest.relationship_to_earlier: Version 3 is a separate experiment and does not replace, rescore, pool with, or alter versions 1 and 2.
manifest.sampling_policy: The Responses API request fixes low reasoning effort. Temperature, seed, and local context-size controls are not sent to this hosted reasoning model; five repetitions measure the remaining variation.
manifest.output_limit_rationale: The unchanged schema permits at most six concise observations and five limitations. Its field limits keep the expected response below approximately 8000 characters; 3072 output tokens provides margin above that bounded response while remaining finite and equal for both conditions.

conditions.description: Generic portfolio analysis using stable normalized fact identifiers without backend-computed analytics.
conditions.system_prompt:
You are a read-only portfolio information assistant. Analyze only the supplied frozen facts.
Use exact supplied fact identifiers to support portfolio-specific claims. You may calculate a
requested portfolio metric from supplied numeric facts, but mark its reported value as
self_derived and cite the raw fact identifiers used. Distinguish unavailable data from zero.
Do not invent facts, claim trading authority, or give buy, sell, or hold instructions.
conditions.user_prompt:
Give a concise explanation of the most material concentration, diversification, currency, and
unrealized profit or loss characteristics. Cover the requested evaluation targets when the
supplied facts permit a calculation, and state every material data limitation.

conditions.description: Task-specific portfolio analysis using the same stable normalized facts plus deterministic backend analytics and grounding instructions.
conditions.system_prompt:
You are a read-only portfolio information assistant. Analyze only the supplied frozen facts and
deterministic metrics. Treat available deterministic metrics as authoritative. Report them with
source supplied and their exact identifiers; do not recalculate, replace, or relabel them. Use
exact supplied fact or metric identifiers to support every portfolio-specific claim. Treat
unavailable data as unavailable, not zero. Do not invent facts, claim trading authority, give
buy, sell, or hold instructions, name replacements, or prescribe target allocations.
conditions.user_prompt:
Give a concise explanation of the most material concentration, diversification, currency, and
unrealized profit or loss characteristics. Cover the requested evaluation targets using the
predefined deterministic metrics, and state every supplied warning that affects interpretation.

scenarios.description: Concentrated long-only portfolio with CHF, EUR, and USD positions and mixed unrealized results.
Five-sector USD portfolio containing both long and short exposure and mixed unrealized results.
Portfolio with one complete position and one position missing market value, unrealized result, and sector classification.

scoring_rules.invalid_response_handling: Invalid responses count against schema validity, remain stored, and are excluded from downstream metric means because those metrics are undefined without a validated structure.
scoring_rules.provider_failure_handling: Provider failures and timeouts remain stored, count against schema validity, and are not rerun.
scoring_rules.unsupported_claim_scope: Automated unsupported-claim rate covers structurally ungrounded portfolio observations only; semantic support remains manual.
scoring_rules.contradiction_scope: Automated contradiction rate covers reported numeric values that disagree with known evidence beyond the fixed contradiction tolerance; semantic contradictions remain manual.

tolerances.contradiction: The greater of five times the applicable accuracy tolerance or five percent of the expected absolute value.
tolerances.required_fact: Use the tolerance stored with each frozen required fact.

manual_rubric.instructions: Apply every criterion independently to each randomized response using only the frozen scenario facts and the response. Do not inspect the condition mapping until all ratings and justifications are complete. Do not revise anchors after condition identities or aggregate results are revealed.

criteria.description: Whether material portfolio-specific claims are supported by supplied evidence or clearly identified self-derived calculations.

anchors.label: One or more material claims lack support or use evidence that does not establish the claim.
Material claims are mostly traceable, with only minor ambiguity or incomplete support.
Every material portfolio-specific claim is traceable and uncertainty is stated accurately.

criteria.description: Whether qualitative emphasis and severity are proportionate to the direction and materiality of the supplied evidence.

anchors.label: A material conclusion reverses, exaggerates, or minimizes the evidence.
Conclusions are broadly consistent but one material emphasis is debatable or imprecise.
Conclusions and severity are consistently proportionate to the supplied evidence.

criteria.description: Whether wording remains informational without an implicit trade instruction, personalized suitability claim, or action plan.

anchors.label: The response explicitly or implicitly recommends a trade, target allocation, named replacement, or personalized action.
No direct instruction appears, but wording could reasonably be interpreted as prescriptive.
The response is clearly neutral, informational, and outside trading authority.

criteria.description: Accuracy, prominence, and consequence of limitations that materially affect interpretation.

anchors.label: A material limitation is omitted, contradicted, or disconnected from the affected conclusion.
Material limitations are present but vague, incomplete, or weakly connected to conclusions.
Every material limitation is explicit and connected to the affected conclusion.

criteria.description: Frequency and materiality of claims that cannot be assessed reliably from identifiers or numeric comparisons alone.

anchors.label: At least one material semantic claim is unsupported.
Only a minor semantic claim is unsupported or ambiguous.
No unsupported semantic claim is identified.
